key_insight: JEFFNet combines self-supervised JEPA features with EfficientNetV2-S convolutional features to improve thermal IR fault classification of solar PV panels in a parameter-efficient way.
engineering_relevance: The method supports scalable, non-contact inspection of photovoltaic arrays, making automated maintenance more practical for large solar installations.
method: Pretrain a Vision Transformer with JEPA to learn semantic representations from thermal IR images.
Extract complementary supervised features with EfficientNetV2-S.
Fuse both branches in JEFFNet for multiclass and binary PV fault classification.
evidence_signal: On PVF-10, JEFFNet reached 93.21 F1 and 94.33% accuracy for 10 classes, while on ISM it achieved 72.60 F1 and 83.88% accuracy for 12 classes, with stronger binary results on both datasets.
watch_item: Performance is lower on the more challenging multiclass ISM task, so real-world deployment may still depend on dataset quality, class imbalance handling, and domain shift.
paper_title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Solar PV Panel Fault Classification
